The criteria require deterministic source provenance to preserve demand-descending rank order, but the supplied upstream function sorts by demand_score ascending. That produced evidence_sources with n06-r08 rank 1 and n06-r01 rank 8, which then caused downstream priority ordering and recommendation to prefer n06-r07 over the highest-demand unsupported need n06-r01. Job 2 appears to follow its supplied handoff ranks, so the supported localization is Job 1, assemble_provenance.
